title: 第5章 签到神象镇狱劲，三岁的灵海境高手！
content_zh:
“叮，恭喜宿主，获得六星奖励，神象镇狱劲！”
系统话音落下后，一股股玄奥的功法口诀，如洪流一般涌入君逍遥脑海当中。
神象镇狱，以气引神，以神成象，举手投足，神象之力，人之一身，十万微粒！
每一微粒，堪比神象！
觉醒十万微粒，则是十万神象之力加身！
一拳之下，开山断海，碎灭星辰，颠覆日月，一念之间！
“神象镇狱劲，好强大的法门，哪怕在君家，像这样的炼体法门都绝不多见。”君逍遥暗暗感叹道。
他也曾翻阅过君家诸多顶级炼体法门，但如神象镇狱劲这样的法门，还是非常稀有的。
“原本以为六星奖励会远不如八星奖励，现在看来，也还不错。”君逍遥心里感叹。
而且君逍遥也明白了，系统奖励，由低到高，分为一星到十星。
一星奖励最普通，十星最极品。
六星奖励已经算是很不错的了。
“这神象镇狱劲，搭配起肉身无双的荒古圣体，简直绝配好吗。”
君逍遥直接是盘坐在地，开始原地参悟起来。
他的本意就是来泰岳古碑签到，并非是来检测肉身实力的。
“人体内十万微粒，先将微粒化为巨象，全部觉醒后，巨象化为龙象，龙象化为元象，元象化为神象。”
君逍遥陷入了参悟。
而泰岳古碑周围的君家子弟，却是齐齐迷惑了。
“怎么回事，我还以为神子大人是来泰岳古碑检测肉身实力的。”
“对啊，为什么直接坐在了地上？”

在这群君家子弟眼中，君逍遥的举动，简直是人类迷惑行为大赏。
他们自然不知道，君逍遥正在参悟神象镇狱劲。
“这种悸动的感觉，莫非他真的是……”君玲珑美眸注视着君逍遥盘坐的背影。
明明只是一个三岁小孩，却如同年幼的神灵一般，给人一种深不可测之感。
“还不能确定，但……并非没有可能……”君玲珑思索着。
君逍遥降生时，引动万圣朝拜，震撼了整个荒天仙域。
在场很多君家弟子，都在猜测君逍遥到底是什么体质。
君战天等人虽然没有刻意隐瞒君逍遥是荒古圣体的消息，但也没有刻意宣扬出去。
所以君家大部分人，还并不清楚君逍遥的体质。
“这就是那位被传的沸沸扬扬的神子吗，感觉也没有三头六臂，而且年纪还这么小，难道他要挑战泰岳古碑不成？”
兰清雅也是在打量着君逍遥。
她眼中倒是没有太多敬畏，毕竟背靠君家第十序列。
很多时候，就算也是一些君家天骄，也不愿招惹兰清雅，怕得罪她背后的君仗剑。
“仗剑公子在泰岳古碑创造了五百万斤记录，便是放眼整个荒天仙域，都是位于顶流，以这位神子现在的境界和年龄，最多也就十万斤吧？”兰清雅心里默默想到。
能得到君仗剑的宠幸，是她这辈子最幸运的事情。
在她眼中，任何人都比不上君仗剑。
包括君逍遥在内。
而君逍遥此刻，却是全身心陷入参悟当中。
隐约间，他感应到了体内十万微粒，好似十万个胚胎，每个胚胎内都蕴藏着一头未觉醒的巨象。
君逍遥调动荒古圣体的金色气血之力。

荒古圣体，可以说是最适合炼体的体质，修炼起神象镇狱劲自然也是事半功倍。
轰隆隆！
很快，君逍遥就感觉，体内的一个微粒破开了，仿佛有一头巨象觉醒，仰天长啸，轰落星辰！
一股神力，随着巨象微粒的觉醒，从君逍遥体内迸发而出。
“一万斤巨力！”君逍遥心神一震。
一头巨象，就代表一万斤巨力。
若君逍遥将体内十万微粒转化为十万巨象之力。
那么就是十亿斤巨力！
而君仗剑也不过才拥有五百万斤巨力而已！
十亿对五百万，差距简直无法比较！
“觉醒了一颗微粒，接下来就方便多了，我倒要看看，荒古圣体一次性能觉醒多少巨象微粒！”君逍遥暗道。
他继续修炼，金色的气血腾空而起，好似在他背后，化为了一头镇压天地的金色神象！
“好强大的气血！”
“那是什么功法，为何我从未见过？”
君逍遥修炼的波动，席卷整个斗武场，无数君家子弟，都是呆呆地看着眼前这一幕。
金色神象，镇压寰宇，象鼻一卷，好似可揽九天明月！
而君逍遥，盘坐于神象之前，如同一尊年幼战神！
轰隆隆！
君逍遥体内，不时传出爆豆之声，那是一颗又一颗的巨象微粒觉醒了。
最终，君逍遥猛然睁开双眼，气血狂涌九重天！

他的境界，竟是在此刻再度突破，从神藏五境大圆满，到达了一个新的境界！
灵海境！
一片金色的灵海，从君逍遥体内开辟而出，浩瀚汹涌，翻天覆地！
“觉醒了一千巨象微粒，还顺带突破到了灵海境！”君逍遥眸光睥睨，气息强绝。
肉身五境，神藏五境之后，便是三个大境界。
灵海九重天，神宫九重天，真灵九重天。
也被称为聚灵海，凝神宫，化真灵！
三岁突破到灵海境者，放眼仙域无数纪年，都找不出几个。
“我没看错吧，神子大人突破到灵海境了？”
一位君家弟子瞪大了眼睛，下巴都快掉到了地上。
“三岁的灵海境高手，嘶……”一群君家子弟倒吸冷气，开始怀疑人生。
别说是他们，就连那隐于虚空之中的君战天，老脸也是有些惊愕。
他原本是来照看君逍遥，害怕君逍遥失败打击他的道心，结果现在，君战天感觉自己的道心受到打击了。
“我孙子简直变态，不过他那门功法，究竟是从何而来，倒真有点东西。”君战天喃喃。
他可是一位圣境大能者，一眼就能看出神象镇狱劲的不凡。
“觉醒了一千巨象微粒，倒是要试一试……”君逍遥看着面前的泰岳古碑，跃跃欲试。
一千颗巨象微粒，就代表了一千万斤巨力！
这已经是第十序列，君仗剑记录的一倍了！
如无意外，君仗剑的记录，怕是无法保持了。
君逍遥单手握拳，澎湃的神力在体内汹涌。

“神子要挑战泰岳古碑了！”
“他能打破君仗剑的记录吗？”
整个斗武场，无数君家弟子，目光都是在此刻汇聚。
兰清雅则是咬着唇，暗自道：“不会的，仗剑公子的记录，不会被任何人打破……”
content_en:
"Ding, congratulations to the host, you have received the six-star reward, the divine elephant's prison-suppressing power!"
After the system's voice fell, a stream of mysterious skills and formulas poured into Jun Xiaoyao's mind like a torrent.
The divine elephant suppresses the prison, uses the air to attract the spirit, uses the spirit to form the image, raises the hands and feet, the power of the divine elephant, one person, one hundred thousand particles!
Every particle is comparable to a divine image!
Awakening one hundred thousand particles will add the power of one hundred thousand divine images!
With one punch, mountains and seas can be opened, stars can be shattered, and the sun and moon can be overturned, all in one thought!
"The Divine Elephant's Prison Suppressing Power is such a powerful method. Even in the Jun family, there are very few body refining methods like this." Jun Xiaoyao sighed secretly.
He has also read through many of the top body-refining methods of the Jun family, but methods like the Divine Elephant Prison-Suppressing Strength are still very rare.
"I originally thought that the six-star reward would be far inferior to the eight-star reward, but now it seems that it is not bad." Jun Xiaoyao sighed inwardly.
And Jun Xiaoyao also understood that the system rewards were divided from one star to ten stars from low to high.
One-star rewards are the most common, and ten-star rewards are the best.
The six-star reward is already pretty good.
"This divine elephant's prison-suppressing power, paired with the unparalleled ancient holy body, is a perfect match, isn't it?"
Jun Xiaoyao sat cross-legged on the ground and began to meditate on the spot.
His original intention was to sign in at the Taiyue Ancient Monument, not to test his physical strength.
"One hundred thousand particles in the human body, first transform the particles into giant elephants. After all awaken, the giant elephants transform into dragon elephants, the dragon elephants transform into Yuanxiangs, and the Yuanxiangs transform into divine elephants."
Jun Xiaoyao fell into meditation.
But the Jun family's children around the Taiyue Ancient Monument were all confused.
"What's going on? I thought Lord Shenzi came to the Taiyue Ancient Monument to test his physical strength."
"Yes, why did you just sit on the ground?"
In the eyes of this group of Jun family disciples, Jun Xiaoyao's behavior is simply a great reward for confusing human behavior.
Of course they didn't know that Jun Xiaoyao was comprehending the divine elephant's prison-suppressing power.
"With this throbbing feeling, could he really be..." Jun Linglong's beautiful eyes stared at the back of Jun Xiaoyao sitting cross-legged.
He is obviously only a three-year-old child, but he is like a young god, giving people an unfathomable feeling.
"It's not certain yet, but...it's not impossible..." Jun Linglong thought.
When Jun Xiaoyao was born, he attracted the worship of all saints and shocked the entire wilderness.
Many Jun family disciples present were speculating on what kind of physique Jun Xiaoyao had.
Although Jun Zhantian and others did not deliberately conceal the news that Jun Xiaoyao was the ancient holy body, they also did not deliberately publicize it.
Therefore, most people in the Jun family still don't know Jun Xiaoyao's physique.
"Is this the son of God who is rumored to be making a lot of noise? He seems to have no head and six arms, and he is still so young. Could it be that he wants to challenge the ancient monument of Taiyue?"
Lan Qingya was also looking at Jun Xiaoyao.
There wasn't much awe in her eyes, after all, she was backed by the tenth rank of the Jun family.
Many times, even some talented people from the Jun family are reluctant to provoke Lan Qingya for fear of offending Jun Zhanjian, who is behind her.
"Master Zhanjian has set a record of five million kilograms on the Taiyue Ancient Monument. Looking at the entire Huangtian Immortal Realm, he is at the top. With the current realm and age of this god's son, he can only weigh one hundred thousand kilograms at most, right?" Lan Qingya thought silently in her heart.
Being favored by Jun Zhanjian is the luckiest thing in her life.
In her eyes, no one can compare to Jun Zhanjian.
Including Jun Xiaoyao.
At this moment, Jun Xiaoyao was completely absorbed in understanding.
Vaguely, he sensed a hundred thousand particles in his body, like a hundred thousand embryos, and each embryo contained an unawakened giant elephant.
Jun Xiaoyao mobilized the golden energy and blood power of the ancient holy body.
The ancient holy body can be said to be the most suitable for physical training. It is natural to practice the divine elephant's prison-suppressing power with twice the result with half the effort.
Boom!
Soon, Jun Xiaoyao felt that a particle in his body had broken open, as if a giant elephant had awakened and roared up to the sky.Blast down the stars!
A burst of divine power burst out from Jun Xiaoyao's body as the giant elephant particles awakened.
"Ten thousand kilograms of power!" Jun Xiaoyao was shocked.
A giant elephant represents a force of ten thousand kilograms.
Ruojun Xiaoyao transforms one hundred thousand particles in his body into the power of one hundred thousand giant elephants.
That’s a billion pounds of power!
And Jun Zhanjian only has a strength of five million kilograms!
One billion versus five million, the difference is simply incomparable!
"After awakening one particle, it will be much more convenient next time. I want to see how many giant elephant particles the Ancient Holy Body can awaken at one time!" Jun Xiaoyao said to himself.
He continued to practice, and the golden energy and blood rose into the sky, as if behind him, it turned into a golden elephant that suppressed the world!
"What a powerful energy and blood!"
"What kind of skill is that? Why have I never seen it before?"
The fluctuations in Jun Xiaoyao's cultivation swept across the entire fighting arena, and countless Jun family disciples stared blankly at the scene in front of them.
The golden elephant suppresses the world, and its trunk seems to be able to hold the bright moon in the sky!
And Jun Xiaoyao, sitting cross-legged in front of the idol, was like a young god of war!
Boom!
From time to time, the sound of exploding beans came out from Jun Xiaoyao's body, which was the awakening of giant elephant particles one after another.
Finally, Jun Xiaoyao suddenly opened his eyes, and his energy and blood surged to the ninth level!
His realm actually broke through again at this moment, from the Great Perfection of the Five Realms of Divine Treasure to a new realm!
Spiritual Sea Realm!
A golden spiritual sea opened up from Jun Xiaoyao's body, vast and turbulent, earth-shaking!
"Awakened a thousand giant elephant particles, and also broke through to the spiritual sea realm!" Jun Xiaoyao's eyes were stern, and his aura was strong.
After the five realms of the physical body and the five realms of the divine treasure, there are three major realms.
The ninth heaven of the spiritual sea, the ninth heaven of the divine palace, and the ninth heaven of the true spirit.
Also known as the Sea of ​​Gathering Spirits, the Palace of Ningshen, and the Transformation of True Spirits!
Looking at the immortal realm for countless years, there are not many people who have broken through to the spiritual sea realm at the age of three.
"Am I right? Lord Shenzi has broken through to the spiritual sea realm?"
A Jun family disciple’s eyes widened and his jaw almost dropped to the ground.
"A three-year-old master of the Linghai Realm, hiss..." A group of Jun family disciples gasped and began to doubt their lives.
Not to mention them, even Jun Zhantian, who was hiding in the void, looked a little shocked.
He originally came to take care of Jun Xiaoyao, fearing that Jun Xiaoyao's failure would hit his Taoist heart. But now, Jun Zhantian feels that his Taoist heart has been hit.
"My grandson is absolutely perverted, but there is something really interesting about where his martial art came from." Jun Zhantian murmured.
He is a powerful person in the holy realm, and the extraordinary power of the divine elephant to suppress prisons can be seen at a glance.
"I have awakened a thousand giant elephant particles, so I want to give it a try..." Jun Xiaoyao looked at the ancient monument of Mount Tai in front of him, eager to try.
One thousand giant elephant particles represent ten million kilograms of force!
This is already the tenth sequence, double the record of Jun Zhanjian!
If nothing unexpected happens, Jun Zhanjian's record may not be maintained.
Jun Xiaoyao clenched a fist with one hand, and surging divine power surged through his body.
"The Son of God is going to challenge the Taiyue Ancient Monument!"
"Can he break Jun's sword-fighting record?"
Throughout the fighting arena, the eyes of countless Jun family disciples gathered at this moment.
Lan Qingya bit her lip and said secretly: "No, Master Zhanjian's record will not be broken by anyone..."
